The '''Ithorian herd''',<ref name="EGtVaV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> also known as the '''clan family''',<ref name="FF122">{{FactFile|122|ITH 1-2|Ithorian Herd Ships}}</ref> was the principal social group of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SJ" /> Each herd built and maintained an [[Ithorian Herdship]].<ref name="FF122" />

{{Family-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ithorian herd was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and released in [[1998]].<ref name="EGtPM" /> However, it was first identified as such in [[Bill Smith]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'', a reference book that was published in [[1993]].<ref name="EGtVaV" /> The [[2001]] article ''[[Starfaring Jungles]]'' in the magazine [[Star Wars Gamer 4|''Star Wars Gamer'' 4]] established the Ithorian herd as a principal social group of their [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SJ" /> Several other sources referred to the [[Ithorian Herdship]]s as "Ithorian herds"<ref name="H&R">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref><ref name="NEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> and "herds" respectively.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="SWS2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="H&R" /><ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
